mapper.select: SELECT sys10_file_id FROM apr01_appr INNER JOIN sys10_file ON apr01_appr_id = sys10_parent_id WHERE apr01_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys10_title_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys10_file_id LIMIT 1

SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , a.apr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , a.apr01_status_cd AS status_code , a.apr01_inout_cd AS in_out_type_code , a.apr01_form_type AS form_type , a.apr01_title AS title , a.apr01_content AS content , to_char(a.apr01_effect_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS effect_date , to_char(a.apr01_reg_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS reg_date , a.apr01_receive_nm AS receive_name , a.apr01_reference_nm AS reference_name , a.apr01_sign_company AS sign_company , a.apr01_sign_ceo AS sign_ceo , s.apr10_stamp_nm AS stamp_name , a.apr01_stamp_position AS stamp_position FROM apr01_appr a LEFT JOIN apr10_stamp s ON s.apr10_stamp_id = a.apr01_stamp_id WHERE a.apr01_appr_id = #{apprId} AND a.apr01_company_id = #{companyId}
